source: Year 1 from UNIBEN (waeup.uniben.edu, core-flagged courses); years 3-5 from FUNAAB (funaab.edu.ng/emt-course-synopsis). Year 2 was not found in any source and is unresearched. "ERM 302" in the FUNAAB list is read as EMT302.

courses.name: General Biology I
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology I: Cell Biology and Diversity of Life
courses.summary: Cell structure and function, biomolecules, genetics and heredity, evolution and the classification of living organisms.

courses.name: General Biology II
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology II: Physiology and Ecology
courses.summary: Plant and animal physiology, reproduction, ecology, ecosystems and environmental biology.

courses.name: General Biology Practical I
courses.summary: Microscopy, cell and tissue observation, dissections and basic biological techniques with drawings.

courses.name: General Biology Practical II
courses.summary: Practicals on plant and animal physiology, ecology sampling and identification.

courses.name: Introductory Botany
courses.summary: Plant cells, structure, reproduction and the plant kingdom.

courses.name: General Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Atomic Structure, Bonding and Physical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Atomic structure, periodic table, bonding, stoichiometry, states of matter, gas laws, thermochemistry and chemical equilibrium.

courses.name: General Chemistry II
courses.summary: Kinetics, electrochemistry, acids and bases, periodic trends, main-group chemistry, and introduction to organic compounds and reactions.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Safe lab practice, volumetric analysis, titrations, qualitative tests and simple physical-chemistry experiments.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry II
courses.summary: Qualitative inorganic analysis, organic functional-group tests, kinetics and electrochemistry experiments.

courses.name: Introduction to Computing Science
courses.summary: Computer basics, hardware, software, number systems and the Internet.

courses.name: Elementary Environmental Science
courses.summary: Ecosystems, natural resources, pollution and environmental problems.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics I
courses.general_name: Pre-calculus: Algebra, Trigonometry and Coordinate Geometry
courses.summary: Sets, number systems, polynomials, inequalities, functions, logarithms, trigonometry, complex numbers and sequences.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics II
courses.summary: Limits, continuity, differentiation, applications of derivatives, integration, areas and volumes, and basic differential equations.

courses.name: General Physics I
courses.general_name: Introductory Mechanics and Properties of Matter
courses.summary: Units and dimensions, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion, gravitation, elasticity and fluids.

courses.name: General Physics II
courses.summary: Electric fields, potential, capacitance, DC circuits, magnetism, induction, AC basics, then waves and optics.

courses.name: General Practical Physics I
courses.summary: Measurement, error analysis and experiments in mechanics, heat and properties of matter, with report writing.

courses.name: General Practical Physics II
courses.summary: Experiments in electricity, magnetism, optics and waves, with graph work and error analysis.

courses.name: The Mammalian Body
courses.summary: Organ systems of mammals: structure and function overview.

courses.name: Animal Diversity
courses.summary: Classification and biology of major animal groups.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: Environment, Ecosystem and Man
courses.summary: Human interactions with ecosystems and environmental change.

courses.name: Principles of Natural Resources Management
courses.summary: Management of land, water, forest and mineral resources.

courses.name: Water Quality Assessment and Pollution Control
courses.general_name: Water Quality Assessment and Pollution Control
courses.summary: Water standards, sampling, analysis and treatment.

courses.name: Hazardous Substances Management
courses.summary: Classification, handling, storage and disposal of hazardous substances.

courses.name: Metals and the Environment
courses.summary: Sources, fate and toxicity of metals in the environment.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Environmental Monitoring Systems and Techniques
courses.summary: Air, water and soil monitoring methods and instrumentation.

courses.name: Environmental Aspects of Farming Systems
courses.summary: Environmental effects of crop and livestock production and agrochemicals.

courses.name: Environmental Education and Awareness
courses.summary: Teaching and communicating environmental issues.

courses.name: Principles of Toxicology I
courses.summary: Toxicant classes, dose-response, absorption, distribution and excretion.

courses.name: Water Analysis
courses.summary: Physical, chemical and biological analysis of water samples.

courses.name: Experimental Pesticide Chemistry and Residue Analysis
courses.general_name: Experimental Pesticide Chemistry and Residue Analysis
courses.summary: Pesticide classes, extraction, chromatography and residue detection.

courses.name: Environmental Law
courses.summary: Environmental statutes, impact assessment and enforcement in Nigeria.

courses.name: Advanced Pesticide Chemistry
courses.summary: Pesticide structure, mode of action, metabolism and resistance.

courses.name: Principles of Toxicology II
courses.summary: Organ toxicity, mutagenesis, carcinogenesis and risk assessment.

courses.name: Waste Management
courses.summary: Waste classification, treatment, recycling and disposal.

courses.name: Principles of Analysis of Toxicants
courses.summary: Sampling and instrumental analysis of toxic substances.

courses.name: Human Settlement and Development
courses.summary: Urban growth, housing, planning and environmental health.

courses.name: Seminar
courses.summary: Student researches a topic, writes a paper and presents it for departmental assessment.

courses.name: Environmental Aspects of Pesticides and Other Toxicants Use
courses.general_name: Environmental Aspects of Pesticides and Other Toxicants Use
courses.summary: Fate and ecological impact of pesticides and toxicants.

courses.name: Structural Elucidation of Organic Pollutants
courses.summary: Spectroscopic identification of organic pollutants.

courses.name: Ecological Disasters and Control
courses.summary: Causes, impacts and management of environmental disasters.

courses.name: Petroleum and the Environment
courses.summary: Oil pollution, spill response and remediation.

courses.name: Miscellaneous Advanced Techniques in Environmental Analysis
courses.general_name: Miscellaneous Advanced Techniques in Environmental Analysis
courses.summary: Advanced instruments and methods in environmental analysis.

courses.name: Project
courses.summary: Supervised independent project: problem definition, literature review, method, results, dissertation and oral defence.
